# Learning Skills
中文
Four skills for Codex and DeepSeek Harness: turn lectures into notes, work through confusing concept
s, write self-contained chapters, and understand complex systems through their evolution.
Each skill is a folder of agent instructions. `course-to-notes` also includes scripts for subtitles,
video frames, and output checks. You can install any of them on its own. The instructions are mainl
y in Chinese; you choose the output language.
## Choose a skill
| What you want to do | Skill |
| Find a course that fits your background, or turn a lecture into notes with timestamps and relevant

images | course-to-notes |
| Understand a project, theory, or institution through its key changes a

| Understand why a definition, method, or s

tep in a proof makes sense | explain-for-understanding |
| Write or substantially revise a lecture c
hapter, including the background needed to follow it | obsidian-lecture-writing |

## Use
The examples below use Codex syntax. In DSH, replace `$skill-name` with `/skill-name`, as shown in t
below use Codex syntax. In DSH, replace `$skill-name` with `/skill-name`, as shown in the DSH guide.
### How an Aircraft Carrier Is Built
The Chinese display name is “航母是怎样建成的”; the invocation identifier remains `evolutionary-understandin
g`. The skill applies to the evolution of complex systems across domains. Both the instructions and
software-history guide are available in English and Chinese through their language links.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The skill selects changes by their effect on behavior and structure, preserves branches and reversal
s, and relates them to the current system. Section titles name the concrete change directly. It also
applies to theories and institutions; it does not promise faster learning or treat a coherent narra
tive as evidence of mastery.
### Work through a concept
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The skill asks Codex to explain what each quantity represents, connect the example to the derivation
, and state when the conclusion applies.
### Turn a lecture into notes
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The workflow preserves the lecture's teaching sequence, derivations, questions, and meaningful repet
ition. Notes include source timestamps and relevant images where the material is available; missing
or unclear material is reported. You can supply learning records to get chapter-level reading sugges
tions; without records, prior learning stays unconfirmed.
It reads the full available transcript first, maps the teaching sequence, then checks visuals at rel
evant source timestamps. Necessary playback can use a supported faster speed, with pauses or slower
review for dense derivations and demonstrations. Transcript gaps and unspoken board work still need
checking; fewer screenshots do not establish complete coverage. This changes the processing workflow
, without guaranteeing a fixed speedup.
If you have not chosen a course, give your background and goal and ask for course recommendations fi
ou have not chosen a course, give your background and goal and ask for course recommendations first.
### Write a chapter
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The skill asks Codex to introduce concepts before relying on them, explain the reasons behind key st
eps, and review the chapter from a reader's position. To save it in Obsidian, specify your vault and
e chapter from a reader's position. To save it in Obsidian, specify your vault and destination file.
Choose `simplify` for a compact, outline-style chapter or systematic review, and `detailed` for step
-by-step explanations, worked examples, and necessary prerequisites. Both preserve key relationships
and conditions. The mode controls explanation detail, not theoretical depth or topic coverage; indi
vidual difficult sections can be expanded without changing the whole chapter. If no mode is specifie
d, the skill uses the current learning purpose and asks only when the distinction materially affects
the result. Syntax and formula lookups remain outside this skill in either mode.
These workflows are for learning and teaching. A formula lookup, translation, or formatting fix can
stay brief. Automatic skill selection depends on the client; use `$skill-name` when you want to choo
tomatic skill selection depends on the client; use `$skill-name` when you want to choose explicitly.
## Requirements
The explanation, chapter-writing, and evolutionary-understanding skills have no script dependencies.
The course helpers use Python 3.10+ and the standard library; extracting video frames also needs `f
fmpeg` and `ffprobe` on `PATH`.
Video access, audio transcription, and Word/PDF export depend on tools available in your agent envir
onment. This repository does not include a video downloader, transcription model, or document conver
nt. This repository does not include a video downloader, transcription model, or document converter.
